title: Concealing LLM-Based Multi-Agent Topology via Phantom Structure Injection
abstract: arXiv:2609.37567v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Driven by the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for collaborative reasoning over complex tasks. A key design element of MAS is the communication topology, which governs information flow among agents and often encodes proprietary knowledge about the system architecture. However, recent work has shown that such topologies can be inferred even in black-box settings by exploiting semantic dependencies in observable reasoning traces, posing significant risks of intellectual property leakage and exposure of system vulnerabilities. To address this threat, we propose MIRAGE, a topology-concealment framework that preserves the genuine communication topology for task execution while shaping adversary-facing semantic evidence toward a carefully constructed phantom topology. translated_title: 通过幻影结构注入隐藏基于大语言模型的多智能体拓扑
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，基于大语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）已成为在复杂任务上进行协作推理的强大范式。MAS的一个关键设计元素是通信拓扑，它控制智能体之间的信息流，并且通常编码着关于系统架构的专有知识。然而，最近的研究表明，即使在黑盒设置下，攻击者也可以通过利用可观察推理轨迹中的语义依赖关系来推断出这种拓扑，这带来了知识产权泄露和系统漏洞暴露的重大风险。为了应对这一威胁，我们提出了MIRAGE，一种拓扑隐藏框架，它在保持真实通信拓扑用于任务执行的同时，将面向对手的语义证据塑造成一个精心构造的幻影拓扑。具体而言，MIRAGE分三个阶段运行：（1）幻影拓扑合成，（2）语义……
tldr: 提出了MIRAGE拓扑隐藏框架，通过注入精心构造的幻影拓扑来误导攻击者的推断，从而在保持多智能体系统真实通信拓扑正常执行任务的同时，防止拓扑结构在黑盒环境下被推断而泄露知识产权和系统漏洞。
en_tdlr: MIRAGE is a topology-concealment framework that protects LLM-based multi-agent systems from black-box topology inference attacks by injecting a carefully constructed phantom topology to mislead adversaries while preserving the genuine communication topology for task execution.
